summary: Endless Candy move replacement stalled after selecting the forget slot
symptom: Sandile's move-learning resolver selected Torment for deletion, then waited for the party tuple while the ROM was waiting for A acknowledgements on the Poof/forgot/And/learned message pages. The resolver timed out and reported move_learning_party_ack_missing even though the UI was progressing correctly.

verified_text: Sandile forgot how to use Torment.
authoritative_evidence.postcondition: field target layer closed, party full HP, battle inactive

root_cause: The resolver treated the party tuple as the only acknowledgement boundary and did not advance the queued field-message pages. Its generic cleanup then risked pressing A on Use on which Pokemon and consuming a second Candy.
fix: Advance only RAM-verified move-learning dialogue pages until the requested move tuple changes; stop at the reusable target prompt and close that layer with B. Add a guard against target-prompt A presses.

regression.live_replay: The live Sandile sequence completed with exactly one Rock Tomb replacement and no second Candy use.

recovery: No savestate load was needed; the live state was corrected by one-page RAM-gated inputs. A verified forward checkpoint was saved after the correction.
